# How much difference arrives

<!-- Generated by tools/research/registry.py; edit the matching JSON record. -->

`how-much-difference-arrives` · **recorded-checked** · theorem · F01 · [record](how-much-difference-arrives.json) · [register](../../../../RESULTS.md)

> Difference arrives exactly as exchanged difference; coupling strength measures sensitivity, zero exactly where insensitive; where the rest follows a law with those strengths, each condition listed once, every gap is at most the carried amount, attained, and positive exactly along routes in time.

<a id="laws--规律"></a>
## Laws

1. The gap of two amounts is what either has beyond the other, the distance on the natural numbers. In two balanced flows the difference of a condition's levels changes across a step by exactly the difference given less the difference taken; with the same formations present, the gap across a step is at most the gap before with every exchange's gap, and does not grow where every exchange is alike. (`Becoming.gap`, `Becoming.Propagation.sub_zero_of_le`, `Becoming.Propagation.sub_le_of_le_add`, `Becoming.Propagation.add_sub_self_left`, `Becoming.Propagation.rearrange`, `Becoming.Propagation.add_congr`, `Becoming.gap_comm`, `Becoming.gap_self`, `Becoming.gap_zero`, `Becoming.gap_add_self`, `Becoming.le_add_gap`, `Becoming.gap_le_of`, `Becoming.gap_le_iff`, `Becoming.gap_eq_zero_iff`, `Becoming.gap_triangle`, `Becoming.gap_add`, `Becoming.gap_mul_le`, `Becoming.gap_total`, `Becoming.gap_of_balances`, `Becoming.Flow.exchangeGap`, `Becoming.levels_step_exact`, `Becoming.gap_step`, `Becoming.Flow.exchangeGap_of_alike`, `Becoming.gap_step_of_alike`)
2. Across a step an exchange is coupled to a condition's level at a step with strength at most k where, under two histories differing in that level only, its take and give differ in all by at most k times that level's gap. For a law of what has stood strength zero is insensitivity and sensitivity is that not every strength is zero; no later level is coupled. A law giving the square of a level has no finite strength. (`Becoming.ExchangeLaw.exchangeGap`, `Becoming.ExchangeLaw.RespondsWithin`, `Becoming.ExchangeLaw.exchangeGap_self`, `Becoming.ExchangeLaw.exchangeGap_triangle`, `Becoming.ExchangeLaw.exchangeGap_of_alike`, `Becoming.ExchangeLaw.alike_of_exchangeGap`, `Becoming.ExchangeLaw.RespondsWithin.mono`, `Becoming.ExchangeLaw.Nonanticipating.respondsWithin_later`, `Becoming.ExchangeLaw.insensitiveAt_iff_strength_zero`, `Becoming.ExchangeLaw.sensitive_iff_strength`, `Becoming.Propagation.Square.law`, `Becoming.Propagation.Square.succ_square`, `Becoming.Propagation.Square.not_respondsWithin`)
3. Strengths add up over levels changed one at a time: mixing the second history in level by level, the exchange's gap is at most the sum of each level's strength times its gap. So likewise under two histories differing up to the step only on listed conditions (with every condition listed, under any two), and the change of a move is at most the part's share, its strengths times the part's change, with the rest's share. (`Becoming.Propagation.mem_steps_of_between`, `Becoming.Propagation.between_of_mem_steps`, `Becoming.Propagation.mem_steps_upto`, `Becoming.Propagation.le_of_mem_steps_upto`, `Becoming.Propagation.mem_map_pair`, `Becoming.Propagation.of_mem_map_pair`, `Becoming.Propagation.mem_append_cases`, `Becoming.cellsOf`, `Becoming.mem_cellsOf`, `Becoming.of_mem_cellsOf`, `Becoming.total_cellsOf`, `Becoming.mixCells`, `Becoming.mixCells_either`, `Becoming.mixCells_listed`, `Becoming.ExchangeLaw.exchangeGap_le_mixCells`, `Becoming.ExchangeLaw.exchangeGap_le_strengths`, `Becoming.ExchangeLaw.exchangeGap_le_strengths_listed`, `Becoming.ExchangeLaw.exchangeGap_le_shares`)
4. The carrying law has the part give its gaps and each formation outside it give what its strengths make of the levels so far, taking nothing; the carried amount is the course it generates from the starting gaps. Where in two balanced flows the rest follows a law of what has stood with those strengths, the part and the start within the given gaps and every condition listed, every gap is at most the carried amount. (`Becoming.ExchangeLaw.carrying`, `Becoming.carried`, `Becoming.carriedGive`, `Becoming.ExchangeLaw.carrying_nonanticipating`, `Becoming.carried_zero`, `Becoming.carried_succ`, `Becoming.carried_le_succ`, `Becoming.Propagation.webOf`, `Becoming.gap_le_carried`)
5. With each condition listed once, the carrying law has those strengths, its course balances, and its gap from the quiet course is exactly the carried amount. So a gap is at most a for every law with those strengths and every two flows of it as above exactly where the carried amount is at most a: the carried amount is the most difference that can arrive. (`Becoming.Propagation.cond_same`, `Becoming.carried_quiet`, `Becoming.carrying_balances`, `Becoming.carried_attained`, `Becoming.ExchangeLaw.carrying_respondsWithin`, `Becoming.most_difference_arrives`)
6. The carried amount is positive exactly where a gap is conveyed along a route in time: a starting gap, holding, a gap of the part, or a positive strength from a level to which a gap was conveyed. Where none is, the two flows' levels agree; where the positive strengths are of formations the level couples into and exchanging with the condition, the routes are routes of TimedResponse's spread. (`Becoming.Conveyed`, `Becoming.Propagation.pos_of_mul_pos`, `Becoming.carriedGive_le`, `Becoming.carried_pos_iff`, `Becoming.Conveyed.spread`, `Becoming.levels_alike_of_not_conveyed`)
7. What two sets of gaps carry together is the sum of what each carries; more gaps and larger strengths carry more. (`Becoming.Propagation.cond_add`, `Becoming.Propagation.cond_le_cond`, `Becoming.carried_add`, `Becoming.carried_mono`)
8. One unit given once, which the rest relays each step to a second condition at twice its level, arrives there as 2t by step t + 1, without bound and with no loop, the carrying course having exactly that gap; returned by a loop of strength one, it arrives as 2^t. (`Becoming.Propagation.total_steps_at`, `Becoming.Propagation.two`, `Becoming.Propagation.every_two`, `Becoming.Propagation.distinct_two`, `Becoming.Propagation.both`, `Becoming.Propagation.unitAct`, `Becoming.Propagation.carried_two_succ`, `Becoming.Propagation.Chain.relay`, `Becoming.Propagation.Chain.amount`, `Becoming.Propagation.Chain.first`, `Becoming.Propagation.Chain.relayed`, `Becoming.Propagation.Chain.keeps_arriving`, `Becoming.Propagation.Chain.gap_arrives`, `Becoming.Propagation.Loop.loop`, `Becoming.Propagation.Loop.amount`, `Becoming.Propagation.Loop.returned`, `Becoming.Propagation.Loop.runaway`)

<a id="conditions--条件"></a>
## Conditions

- No axiom. What each law needs is written into it: two balanced flows with the same formations present; the rest following a law of what has stood (Nonanticipating, Follows); the coupling strengths (RespondsWithin) as supplied bounds; bounds on the part's gaps and the starting gaps; every condition listed (every), each once where the amount is attained (Distinct); decided equality of conditions only for mixing.

<a id="does-not-show--未表明"></a>
## Does not show

- Which strengths a given law has: they enter every theorem as supplied bounds, and the least one would need RespondsWithin decided for each k.
- Reading what has stood does not imply a finite coupling strength. Witness: `Becoming.Propagation.Square.not_respondsWithin`.
- A bounded input does not imply a bounded arrival: one unit given once arrives without bound through a chain, with no loop, under the carrying law, which takes nothing and so is not gainless; for gainless laws this is not shown. Witness: `Becoming.Propagation.Chain.keeps_arriving`.
- For a particular law the actual gap can be far below the carried amount: it bounds every law with those strengths and is attained by the carrying law, which takes nothing and is not gainless; tightness over gainless laws is not shown.
- Strengths below one: amounts are natural numbers, so a decaying exchange is bounded only by strength one and the decay of a difference does not show here; likewise real amounts and infinitely many conditions.
- A general theory of loops, the strength around any loop and its runaway, of which there are only witnesses here; how a center represents what it reaches.
- **Counterexample:** The law exchanging the square of a level reads what has stood and has no finite strength on that level: a finite strength is a condition on a law, not given with every law. [source](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Propagation.lean)
- **Counterexample:** One unit given once, relayed each step at twice its level to a second condition, arrives there without bound with no loop: levels hold what they are given. The relaying law takes nothing and gives twice a level, so it is not gainless. [source](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Propagation.lean)

<a id="correspondence--对应"></a>
### Correspondence

Ren, 12 October 2026, the goal: “move towards 100%, you can spawn a few agents for help, pick the "What would move it most next" first, and don't stop until we are 100%”. This result answers the item of six records' next_delta on how much difference arrives and a measure of coupling. Readings (the AI's, adopted on Ren's delegation, DELEGATED-CHOICES D39; the word 识 itself stays Ren's): the coupling strength is the measure sensitivity lacked, read formally as how strongly a level couples into a formation; how much difference arrives is itself a course one law generates in the one unfolding, not added to it; a held difference keeps arriving (shown under the carrying law, which takes nothing and is not gainless, not for gainless laws); in Ren's sentence, “heavily coupled into it” reads as coupling strength and “a highly entangled system” as couplings that lie on loops through the whole, how highly being the strengths along the loops and how often they act, not as quantum entanglement (revised and taken by Ren on 18 October 2026, DELEGATED-CHOICES D39). In systems terms the strengths are incremental gains (Lipschitz bounds) and the carried amount is their comparison system (a discrete Grönwall inequality), here attained. The name "coupling strength" follows the scope of levels-of-closure ("does not measure the strength of coupling"), leaving "gain" to P111.
